title: Verify: Lifecycle, snapshot freeze and Git head unit tests
summary: Unit tests with fake committer, fixed clock and temp dir
description: Test Open/Close/Create, snapshot immutability, Head and ErrFrozen with fakes.
acceptance_criteria: Open sets 24h window and base release
Close writes snapshot, records fake SHA, status CLOSED, and a second Close fails
FileStore.Save into a frozen round returns ErrFrozen and creates no file
CLI.Head returns trimmed SHA from a fake Runner
technical_constraints: Fake committer records calls; fake clock; t.TempDir

steps.action: Use fakeGit{head:"abc123"} recording Commit paths, a fixed Now, a stub Contributions returning two contributions. Assert Open yields EndsAt=StartsAt+24h and BaseRelease "1.0.0"; Close creates snapshot.yaml with 2 entries (mode 0o444), FreezeCommit=="abc123", Status CLOSED, committed paths include snapshot.yaml; Close on SCHEDULED round returns ErrIllegalTransition and no snapshot.yaml; second Close errors and snapshot bytes unchanged; Create with an OPEN round present returns ErrActiveRound
steps.expected: Lifecycle tests pass (go test reports PASS)

steps.action: With fakeCommitter and t.TempDir, create worlds/w/rounds/round-0000001/snapshot.yaml then Save a Contribution for that round; assert errors.Is ErrFrozen and no *.md created; separately save two contributions and assert ListByRound returns both oldest first
steps.expected: Frozen and ListByRound tests pass (go test reports PASS)

steps.action: Fake Runner returns "deadbeef\n"; assert Head returns "deadbeef" and args were rev-parse HEAD; a failing runner returns an error
